- **Clause 1**: Confidentiality of the Foreign Service Oral Assessment content.
- **Clause 2**: Prohibition on disclosing, publishing, reproducing, or transmitting examination material.
- **Clause 3**: Prohibition on recreating material by memory post-exam.
- **Other clauses** mention consistency with existing laws, whistleblower protections, etc.

Now, looking at each hypothesis:

**nda-4**: "Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement." The evidence points to clause 2, which says they can't disclose, publish, reproduce, or transmit any material. This seems to align with limited use, so **Entailment** with span 5.

**nda-1**: "All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party." The NDA doesn't mention explicit identification; it just says they must keep certain content confidential. So **NotMentioned**.

**nda-2**: "Confidential Information shall only include technical information." The NDA refers to "examination material" which might be technical, but it doesn't exclude non-technical info. So **NotMentioned**.

**nda-3**: "Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information." The NDA mentions "content of the Foreign Service Oral Assessment" which is verbal. So **Entailment** with span 4.

**nda-5**: "Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees." The NDA doesn't address sharing with employees, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-7**: "Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties..." The NDA doesn't mention third parties, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-8**: "Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case required by law to disclose..." The NDA doesn't mention legal compulsion, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-10**: "Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed..." The NDA doesn't mention confidentiality of the agreement itself, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-12**: "Receiving Party may independently develop similar info." The NDA prohibits recreating material by memory (clause 3), but doesn't explicitly ban independent development. So **NotMentioned**.

**nda-13**: "Receiving Party may acquire similar info from third parties." The NDA doesn't address acquiring similar info, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-15**: "Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information." The NDA requires confidentiality but doesn't explicitly state no rights, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-17**: "Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information..." The NDA prohibits reproducing (clause 2), so this would be a **Contradiction** with span 5.

**nda-18**: "Receiving Party shall not solicit some representatives." Not mentioned, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-19**: "Some obligations may survive termination." The NDA mentions obligations under existing laws (span 8-13), so **Entailment** with spans 8-13.

**nda-20**: "Receiving Party may retain some info post-agreement." The NDA doesn't mention retention after termination, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-11**: "No reverse engineering." Not mentioned, so **NotMentioned**.

**nda-16**: "Destroy or return info upon termination." The NDA doesn't specify this, so **NotMentioned**.

I need to ensure each decision is based strictly on the NDA text, without external knowledge. For example, nda-17 contradicts clause 2's prohibition on reproducing, so it's a contradiction. Similarly, nda-4 is supported by clause 2's restrictions. All other hypotheses aren't addressed in the NDA.
